scheme_name: Compensation Amount Towards Cattle Injury Caused by Forest Animals
other_conditions: The cattle must have been injured by a wild animal as defined under the Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972.
The incident must be reported to the nearest forest officer within 48 hours of its occurrence, either in writing or verbally.
The owner must provide necessary proof or verification documents as required by the Forest Department.
The dead cattle must not be removed from the place of death.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹1,00,000 compensation for cattle injury, including ₹1,000 immediate assistance, ₹30,000 for medical expenses, and ₹1,00,000 for permanent disability.
